name: Rosa Delgado

five_sec.what_is_it: It texts the whole family the dinner ideas, they pick, and the list goes in Walmart or Instacart
five_sec.trust_why: Simple words, says no card, says they don't deliver. But no big family in the picture
five_sec.next_step: Tap 'See a sample week' to see if it's real food
five_sec.delivers_food_why: The green part says 'We don't deliver food'

full_page.what_stopped_me: Good things: 1) everybody votes by text, and we already live on texts, 2) it shows dollars, $64 for the week and a 'Budget $100/week' button, 3) Walmart. But the sample is 'serves 4' and 'Family of 4'. I'm seven. Low-sodium only shows up as a tiny 'Heart-healthy dinners' link at the very bottom. No Spanish for Lupe, no H-E-B
full_page.whats_missing: A family of 7 example; a low-sodium setting I can see; Spanish; H-E-B

DD.quote: I like that it texts everybody and shows $64 for the week. But 'family of 4', mija? Show me seven, and something for my suegra's salt.

five_sec.what_is_it: Meal plans in an app, with a video
five_sec.trust_why: Happy mom and little girl, looks like a real company
five_sec.delivers_food_why: 'Less Stress, More Dinners' and a kitchen; I'm not sure if they send food

full_page.what_stopped_me: They have a 'Heart Healthy' plan, which is what Lupe needs, and 'Budget Friendly' and Walmart. But no price that I can see, it doesn't say how many people, and 'Pork Chops with Rosemary-Mustard Sauce' and 'Shrimp Po' Boys' are not what my kids eat

EM.quote: Oye, a Heart Healthy plan, that's what Lupe needs. But how much? It doesn't say, and Rosemary-Mustard pork chops is not my kitchen.

five_sec.what_is_it: Food boxes they send to your house
five_sec.trust_why: 'Open a box to reveal your offer', like a game at the fair
five_sec.delivers_food_why: Boxes with their name and 'Free Meals'

full_page.what_stopped_me: Boxes never made sense for seven. 'Chef-crafted' recipes, and the price is hidden until I put in a zip
full_page.whats_missing: A price; anything low-sodium for a heart patient

HF.quote: 'Bold, chef-crafted recipes' and a box to open for a prize. For seven people that's a car payment. No, gracias.

five_sec.what_is_it: An app on the phone that picks dinner
five_sec.delivers_food_why: Pictures of food on a phone, maybe they bring it?

full_page.what_stopped_me: $25 a month for 'messages'. The reviews say 'family of 4'. Nothing about low salt or Spanish
full_page.whats_missing: Low-sodium; big family; a cheap price

OL.quote: Twenty-five dollars a month for 'messages'? I text my sister for free. And nothing about low salt.

five_sec.what_is_it: An app for recipes and grocery lists
five_sec.delivers_food_why: It's app store buttons and lists

full_page.what_stopped_me: It's an empty recipe book. I know how to make arroz and fideo; I need someone to tell me how to make it low-salt for seven

PTE.quote: Nice that it says no card. But it's an empty recipe book; I already know my recipes, I need them low-salt.

dd_offer.why: Free forever, Family free 14 days, then $4.99: I had to read it twice to see which part is free for always
dd_offer.expect_day_15: The texting part stops and I keep the free plan. Nobody charges me because I never gave a card.

head_to_head.reason: It's free, it goes to Walmart, it shows the week in dollars, and the whole family can vote by text

EM.reason: eMeals has the heart plan, but no price and no family size; DinnerDrop is free and shows dollars

PTE.reason: Plan to Eat is an empty book; DinnerDrop gives me the dinners

OL.reason: DinnerDrop is free; Ollie is $25 for messages

HF.reason: Boxes for seven people is crazy money

dd_fix_that_would_move_me: Home page sample week: add a 'Family of 7' and a 'Low-sodium / heart-healthy' tab next to Kid-friendly and Gluten-free, and say how many people it can plan for.
